score_definitions.mean_angle_to_mean_direction: mean_i arccos(hat(h_i)^T mu), mu = sum_i hat(h_i) / ||sum_i hat(h_i)||; radians
score_definitions.spectral_top1_share: sigma_1(H)^2 / sum_j sigma_j(H)^2; H is raw and uncentred
score_definitions.pairwise_cosine: mean over i != j of cos(h_i, h_j)

layer_numbering: entry i is hidden_states[i]: 0 = embedding output; 1..L = transformer-layer outputs
auroc_orientation: score as written, label 1 = machine; AUROC below 0.5 means the score is lower for machine text
